Peterson & Barney (1952) Vowel Acoustic Data

Source: R/data.R
pb52.Rd

Acoustic measurements of 10 American English vowels produced by 76 speakers (men, women, and children) in /h-V-d/ words. This dataset is a standardized copy of the dataset bundled in the phonTools package (Barreda 2015) , originally published by Peterson and Barney (1952) .

Usage

data(pb52)

Format

A tibble with 1,520 rows and 9 variables:

speaker

Speaker identifier as a factor.

sex

Speaker sex as a factor with levels "female" and "male".

type

Speaker demographic group as a factor with levels "men", "women", and "children".

vowel

Standardized Unicode IPA vowel label in phonemic slashes as a factor with 10 levels (see levels(pb52$vowel)).

repetition

Repetition index (1 or 2).

f0

Fundamental frequency in Hertz (Hz).

f1

First formant frequency in Hertz (Hz).

f2

Second formant frequency in Hertz (Hz).

f3

Third formant frequency in Hertz (Hz).

Source

Standardized from phonTools::pb52 (Barreda 2015) .

References

Peterson GE, Barney HL (1952). “Control methods used in a study of the vowels.” The Journal of the Acoustical Society of America, 24(2), 175–184.

Barreda S (2015). “phonTools: Functions for phonetics in R.” R package version 0.2-2.1. https://CRAN.R-project.org/package=phonTools.

See also

h95, swehvd, mixer6

Examples

data(pb52)
head(pb52)
#> # A tibble: 6 × 9
#>   speaker sex   type  vowel repetition    f0    f1    f2    f3
#>   <fct>   <fct> <fct> <fct>      <int> <dbl> <dbl> <dbl> <dbl>
#> 1 1       male  men   /i/            1   160   240  2280  2850
#> 2 1       male  men   /i/            2   186   280  2400  2790
#> 3 1       male  men   /ɪ/            1   203   390  2030  2640
#> 4 1       male  men   /ɪ/            2   192   310  1980  2550
#> 5 1       male  men   /ɛ/            1   161   490  1870  2420
#> 6 1       male  men   /ɛ/            2   155   570  1700  2600
summary(pb52[, c("f0", "f1", "f2", "f3")])
#>        f0              f1               f2             f3      
#>  Min.   : 91.0   Min.   : 190.0   Min.   : 560   Min.   :1400  
#>  1st Qu.:133.0   1st Qu.: 420.0   1st Qu.:1100   1st Qu.:2370  
#>  Median :200.0   Median : 540.0   Median :1470   Median :2680  
#>  Mean   :191.3   Mean   : 563.3   Mean   :1624   Mean   :2708  
#>  3rd Qu.:238.0   3rd Qu.: 681.0   3rd Qu.:2100   3rd Qu.:3030  
#>  Max.   :350.0   Max.   :1300.0   Max.   :3610   Max.   :4380
